_comment: Memory MCP server registration. Merge into the 'mcpServers' object in ~/.claude.json. Adjust 'args' to point at your built dist/index.js. MEMORY_INSTANCE_NAME is optional but recommended for multi-machine setups (one machine writes 'fedora', another writes 'mele', etc., and observations are tagged at write time so audit/freshness hooks can filter by source).
_comment_embedding: The five MEMORY_EMBED_*/threshold vars are OPTIONAL and move as ONE unit — they describe the embedding model's cosine geometry. Omit all five to run the MiniLM default (thresholds 0.85/0.80/0.25 are MiniLM-tuned). The values below are the source machine's live granite-r2 cutover (2026-07-02: won the in-domain blind panel 14/18; thresholds percentile-mapped by scripts/recalibrate-thresholds.py). Switching models later is safe: the v15 vec_config guard clears stale vectors and the background sweep re-embeds — but ALWAYS recalibrate the three thresholds for the new model's geometry.
